cause_quote: The cold-archive feature added `storage TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (storage IN ('file', 'sqlite'))` rows whose payloads live in sibling cold files, and extended backups to embed them, but left the existing update candidate snapshot (update-candidate-state.ts) copying only database rows.
user_saw: An update to the 2026.11.5 candidate rolled back because the rehearsal Doctor reported an intact cold transcript archive as missing.
summary: The update candidate snapshot now hard-links or copies the file-backed cold archive payloads referenced by copied agent databases and budgets their bytes in the inventory.
reasoning: The candidate state snapshot (d1a69c0b209, 2026-09-06) predates file-backed cold archives, which arrived in aa0ad4c7804 (2026-09-11) with external payload files and backup support but no change to update-candidate-state.ts; the fix's PR confirms no cold-file copy ever ran in the snapshot. I treat the gap as shipped with the cold-archive feature rather than a later regression; it could also be read as latent with that commit as trigger, and I did not confirm which Doctor path first read the missing payloads in rehearsal.
